```{r}
# Logistic regression for selected RefSeq fungal and viral genera

rm(list = ls())

metadata_file_tsv <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project/Data/metadata_clean.tsv"

fungal_file <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project/Data/refseq_fungal_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"

viral_file <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project/Data/refseq_viral_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"

output_dir <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project/Logistic_regression"

if(!dir.exists(output_dir)){
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Selected candidate genera carried forward from the shortlist

fungal_candidates <- c(
  "Puccinia",
  "Saccharomyces",
  "Fusarium",
  "Rhizophagus",
  "Aspergillus",
  "Cryptococcus",
  "Lachancea",
  "Trichoderma"
)

viral_candidates <- c(
  "Shenzhenivirus",
  "Certrevirus",
  "Cukevirus",
  "Fohxhuevirus",
  "Oryzopoxvirus"
)

# Metadata is matched using reads_ID only

meta <- read.delim(
  metadata_file_tsv,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)

colnames(meta)[1] <- "sample_label"

meta$bmi <- as.numeric(meta$bmi)

# Function to read a RefSeq genus table and match metadata safely

read_and_match <- function(file, meta){
  
  mat <- read.delim(
    file,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  matrix_ids_clean <- sub("_1$", "", rownames(mat))
  
  unmatched <- setdiff(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID)
  
  if(length(unmatched) > 0){
    stop("Unmatched samples found: ", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  meta_matched <- meta[
    match(matrix_ids_clean, meta$reads_ID),
  ]
  
  if(!all(meta_matched$reads_ID == matrix_ids_clean)){
    stop("Metadata order mismatch")
  }
  
  rownames(mat) <- matrix_ids_clean
  
  list(
    mat = mat,
    meta = meta_matched
  )
}

fungal_data <- read_and_match(fungal_file, meta)
viral_data  <- read_and_match(viral_file, meta)

# Convert count-like data to relative abundance.
# If the table is already relative abundance, this will leave it unchanged.

to_relative_abundance <- function(mat){
  
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"
  
  row_sums <- rowSums(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if(max(row_sums, na.rm = TRUE) > 1.5){
    mat <- sweep(mat, 1, row_sums, "/")
    mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
  }
  
  mat
}

fungal_mat <- to_relative_abundance(fungal_data$mat)
viral_mat  <- to_relative_abundance(viral_data$mat)

fungal_meta <- fungal_data$meta
viral_meta  <- viral_data$meta

# Outcome coding.
# The event is coded as 1 so odds ratios represent higher odds of the outcome.

make_binary_outcome <- function(x, event_level, reference_level){
  
  x <- as.character(x)
  
  keep <- x %in% c(event_level, reference_level)
  
  y <- ifelse(x == event_level, 1,
              ifelse(x == reference_level, 0, NA))
  
  list(
    y = y,
    keep = keep
  )
}

# Logistic regression function for one taxon and one outcome

run_logistic_model <- function(mat, meta, taxon, domain,
                               outcome_column,
                               event_level,
                               reference_level,
                               adjust_bmi = FALSE){
  
  if(!taxon %in% colnames(mat)){
    return(data.frame(
      taxon = taxon,
      domain = domain,
      outcome = outcome_column,
      comparison = paste(event_level, "vs", reference_level),
      model = ifelse(adjust_bmi, "BMI-adjusted", "Unadjusted"),
      n = NA,
      n_event = NA,
      n_reference = NA,
      n_nonzero = NA,
      estimate = NA,
      odds_ratio = NA,
      ci_lower = NA,
      ci_upper = NA,
      p_value = NA,
      stability_flag = "Taxon not found",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  outcome_data <- make_binary_outcome(
    meta[[outcome_column]],
    event_level = event_level,
    reference_level = reference_level
  )
  
  abundance <- as.numeric(mat[, taxon])
  
  # Small pseudocount allows zero values to be retained after log transformation
  
  pseudocount <- min(abundance[abundance > 0], na.rm = TRUE) / 2
  
  if(is.infinite(pseudocount) | is.na(pseudocount)){
    pseudocount <- 1e-10
  }
  
  taxon_log <- log10(abundance + pseudocount)
  
  df <- data.frame(
    y = outcome_data$y,
    taxon = taxon_log,
    bmi = meta$bmi
  )
  
  if(adjust_bmi){
    df <- df[complete.cases(df[, c("y", "taxon", "bmi")]), ]
    formula_use <- y ~ taxon + bmi
  } else {
    df <- df[complete.cases(df[, c("y", "taxon")]), ]
    formula_use <- y ~ taxon
  }
  
  n_event <- sum(df$y == 1)
  n_reference <- sum(df$y == 0)
  n_nonzero <- sum(abundance[rownames(meta) %in% rownames(meta)] > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if(nrow(df) < 10 | n_event < 3 | n_reference < 3){
    return(data.frame(
      taxon = taxon,
      domain = domain,
      outcome = outcome_column,
      comparison = paste(event_level, "vs", reference_level),
      model = ifelse(adjust_bmi, "BMI-adjusted", "Unadjusted"),
      n = nrow(df),
      n_event = n_event,
      n_reference = n_reference,
      n_nonzero = sum(abundance > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      estimate = NA,
      odds_ratio = NA,
      ci_lower = NA,
      ci_upper = NA,
      p_value = NA,
      stability_flag = "Insufficient outcome counts",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  warnings_found <- character()
  
  fit <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      glm(
        formula_use,
        data = df,
        family = binomial()
      ),
      warning = function(w){
        warnings_found <<- c(warnings_found, conditionMessage(w))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    ),
    error = function(e){
      return(NULL)
    }
  )
  
  if(is.null(fit)){
    return(data.frame(
      taxon = taxon,
      domain = domain,
      outcome = outcome_column,
      comparison = paste(event_level, "vs", reference_level),
      model = ifelse(adjust_bmi, "BMI-adjusted", "Unadjusted"),
      n = nrow(df),
      n_event = n_event,
      n_reference = n_reference,
      n_nonzero = sum(abundance > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      estimate = NA,
      odds_ratio = NA,
      ci_lower = NA,
      ci_upper = NA,
      p_value = NA,
      stability_flag = "Model failed",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  coef_table <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  
  if(!"taxon" %in% rownames(coef_table)){
    stability_flag <- "Taxon coefficient unavailable"
    
    return(data.frame(
      taxon = taxon,
      domain = domain,
      outcome = outcome_column,
      comparison = paste(event_level, "vs", reference_level),
      model = ifelse(adjust_bmi, "BMI-adjusted", "Unadjusted"),
      n = nrow(df),
      n_event = n_event,
      n_reference = n_reference,
      n_nonzero = sum(abundance > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      estimate = NA,
      odds_ratio = NA,
      ci_lower = NA,
      ci_upper = NA,
      p_value = NA,
      stability_flag = stability_flag,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  estimate <- coef_table["taxon", "Estimate"]
  se <- coef_table["taxon", "Std. Error"]
  p_value <- coef_table["taxon", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  odds_ratio <- exp(estimate)
  ci_lower <- exp(estimate - 1.96 * se)
  ci_upper <- exp(estimate + 1.96 * se)
  
  stability_flag <- "Valid"
  
  if(length(warnings_found) > 0){
    stability_flag <- paste(unique(warnings_found), collapse = "; ")
  }
  
  if(is.infinite(odds_ratio) | is.infinite(ci_lower) | is.infinite(ci_upper) |
     ci_upper > 1000 | ci_lower < 0.001){
    stability_flag <- paste(stability_flag, "Potentially unstable estimate", sep = "; ")
  }
  
  if(sum(abundance > 0, na.rm = TRUE) < 5){
    stability_flag <- paste(stability_flag, "Very low detection count", sep = "; ")
  }
  
  data.frame(
    taxon = taxon,
    domain = domain,
    outcome = outcome_column,
    comparison = paste(event_level, "vs", reference_level),
    model = ifelse(adjust_bmi, "BMI-adjusted", "Unadjusted"),
    n = nrow(df),
    n_event = n_event,
    n_reference = n_reference,
    n_nonzero = sum(abundance > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    estimate = estimate,
    odds_ratio = odds_ratio,
    ci_lower = ci_lower,
    ci_upper = ci_upper,
    p_value = p_value,
    stability_flag = stability_flag,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Run models for all selected taxa

all_results <- list()

for(taxon in fungal_candidates){
  
  all_results[[length(all_results) + 1]] <- run_logistic_model(
    mat = fungal_mat,
    meta = fungal_meta,
    taxon = taxon,
    domain = "Fungal",
    outcome_column = "outcome",
    event_level = "sPTB",
    reference_level = "TERM",
    adjust_bmi = FALSE
  )
  
  all_results[[length(all_results) + 1]] <- run_logistic_model(
    mat = fungal_mat,
    meta = fungal_meta,
    taxon = taxon,
    domain = "Fungal",
    outcome_column = "outcome",
    event_level = "sPTB",
    reference_level = "TERM",
    adjust_bmi = TRUE
  )
  
  all_results[[length(all_results) + 1]] <- run_logistic_model(
    mat = fungal_mat,
    meta = fungal_meta,
    taxon = taxon,
    domain = "Fungal",
    outcome_column = "sPTB34",
    event_level = "yes",
    reference_level = "no",
    adjust_bmi = FALSE
  )
  
  all_results[[length(all_results) + 1]] <- run_logistic_model(
    mat = fungal_mat,
    meta = fungal_meta,
    taxon = taxon,
    domain = "Fungal",
    outcome_column = "sPTB34",
    event_level = "yes",
    reference_level = "no",
    adjust_bmi = TRUE
  )
}

for(taxon in viral_candidates){
  
  all_results[[length(all_results) + 1]] <- run_logistic_model(
    mat = viral_mat,
    meta = viral_meta,
    taxon = taxon,
    domain = "Viral",
    outcome_column = "outcome",
    event_level = "sPTB",
    reference_level = "TERM",
    adjust_bmi = FALSE
  )
  
  all_results[[length(all_results) + 1]] <- run_logistic_model(
    mat = viral_mat,
    meta = viral_meta,
    taxon = taxon,
    domain = "Viral",
    outcome_column = "outcome",
    event_level = "sPTB",
    reference_level = "TERM",
    adjust_bmi = TRUE
  )
  
  all_results[[length(all_results) + 1]] <- run_logistic_model(
    mat = viral_mat,
    meta = viral_meta,
    taxon = taxon,
    domain = "Viral",
    outcome_column = "sPTB34",
    event_level = "yes",
    reference_level = "no",
    adjust_bmi = FALSE
  )
  
  all_results[[length(all_results) + 1]] <- run_logistic_model(
    mat = viral_mat,
    meta = viral_meta,
    taxon = taxon,
    domain = "Viral",
    outcome_column = "sPTB34",
    event_level = "yes",
    reference_level = "no",
    adjust_bmi = TRUE
  )
}

logistic_results <- do.call(rbind, all_results)

# Format values for easier reading in thesis tables

logistic_results$odds_ratio <- round(logistic_results$odds_ratio, 3)
logistic_results$ci_lower <- round(logistic_results$ci_lower, 3)
logistic_results$ci_upper <- round(logistic_results$ci_upper, 3)
logistic_results$p_value <- signif(logistic_results$p_value, 3)

logistic_results$or_95ci <- ifelse(
  is.na(logistic_results$odds_ratio),
  NA,
  paste0(
    logistic_results$odds_ratio,
    " (",
    logistic_results$ci_lower,
    "–",
    logistic_results$ci_upper,
    ")"
  )
)

# Export complete results

write.csv(
  logistic_results,
  file.path(output_dir, "selected_refseq_taxa_logistic_regression_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Export a cleaner thesis table

thesis_table <- logistic_results[, c(
  "domain",
  "taxon",
  "outcome",
  "comparison",
  "model",
  "n",
  "n_event",
  "n_reference",
  "n_nonzero",
  "or_95ci",
  "p_value",
  "stability_flag"
)]

write.csv(
  thesis_table,
  file.path(output_dir, "selected_refseq_taxa_logistic_regression_thesis_table.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Separate fungal and viral outputs

write.csv(
  subset(thesis_table, domain == "Fungal"),
  file.path(output_dir, "fungal_logistic_regression_thesis_table.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  subset(thesis_table, domain == "Viral"),
  file.path(output_dir, "viral_logistic_regression_thesis_table.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# View results in R

print(thesis_table)
```

```{r}
# BMI-adjusted logistic regression tables and forest plots
# Only statistically significant and stable taxa are plotted

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

output_dir <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project/Logistic_regression"

results_file <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "selected_refseq_taxa_logistic_regression_results.csv"
)

plot_dir <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "BMI_adjusted_significant_stable_tables_and_plots"
)

if(!dir.exists(plot_dir)){
  dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

logistic_results <- read.csv(results_file, check.names = FALSE)

fungal_colours <- c(
  "Schizosaccharomyces" = "#B143A8",
  "Lodderomyces" = "#F0E442",
  "Saccharomyces" = "#56B4E9",
  "Candida" = "#009E73",
  "Kwoniella" = "#DDCC77",
  "Coccidioides" = "#D55E00",
  "Aspergillus" = "#E69F00",
  "Fusarium" = "#44AA99",
  "Trichoderma" = "#CC6677",
  "Nakaseomyces" = "#882255",
  "Puccinia" = "#0072B2",
  "Rhizophagus" = "#332288",
  "Cryptococcus" = "#88CCEE",
  "Lachancea" = "#117733",
  "Sugiyamaella" = "#AA4499",
  "Thermothele" = "#999933",
  "Drechmeria" = "#661100",
  "Eremothecium" = "#6699CC",
  "Zymoseptoria" = "#AA4466",
  "Other" = "#BDBDBD"
)

viral_colours <- c(
  "Spinunavirus" = "#B143A8",
  "Orthoflavivirus" = "#DDCC77",
  "Alphapapillomavirus" = "#E69F00",
  "Gettysburgvirus" = "#44AA99",
  "Schiekvirus" = "#CC6677",
  "Gelderlandvirus" = "#88CCEE",
  "Epseptimavirus" = "#009E73",
  "Aurunvirus" = "#D55E00",
  "Moonvirus" = "#332288",
  "Cukevirus" = "#56B4E9",
  "Shenzhenivirus" = "#CC79A7",
  "Oryzopoxvirus" = "#0072B2",
  "Certrevirus" = "#882255",
  "Fohxhuevirus" = "#999933",
  "Gorganvirus" = "#661100",
  "Moturavirus" = "#6699CC",
  "Shandvirus" = "#AA4466",
  "Cytomegalovirus" = "#F0E442",
  "Other" = "#BDBDBD"
)

bmi_results <- logistic_results %>%
  filter(model == "BMI-adjusted") %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_label = case_when(
      outcome == "outcome" ~ "TERM vs sPTB",
      outcome == "sPTB34" ~ "sPTB <34 weeks vs others",
      TRUE ~ outcome
    ),
    OR_95CI = ifelse(
      is.na(odds_ratio),
      NA,
      paste0(odds_ratio, " (", ci_lower, "–", ci_upper, ")")
    ),
    stable_estimate = case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~ FALSE,
      is.na(odds_ratio) ~ FALSE,
      is.na(ci_lower) ~ FALSE,
      is.na(ci_upper) ~ FALSE,
      is.infinite(odds_ratio) ~ FALSE,
      is.infinite(ci_lower) ~ FALSE,
      is.infinite(ci_upper) ~ FALSE,
      n_nonzero < 5 ~ FALSE,
      grepl(
        "failed|insufficient|separation|unstable|very low detection",
        stability_flag,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ FALSE,
      TRUE ~ TRUE
    ),
    significant = ifelse(!is.na(p_value) & p_value < 0.05, TRUE, FALSE),
    plot_status = case_when(
      significant == TRUE & stable_estimate == TRUE ~ "Significant and stable",
      significant == TRUE & stable_estimate == FALSE ~ "Significant but unstable",
      significant == FALSE & stable_estimate == TRUE ~ "Stable but not significant",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant and/or unstable"
    )
  )

make_table_and_plot <- function(data,
                                domain_name,
                                outcome_name,
                                file_stub,
                                plot_title,
                                colour_palette){
  
  df <- data %>%
    filter(
      domain == domain_name,
      outcome == outcome_name
    ) %>%
    arrange(p_value)
  
  full_table <- df %>%
    select(
      domain,
      taxon,
      outcome_label,
      comparison,
      n,
      n_event,
      n_reference,
      n_nonzero,
      odds_ratio,
      ci_lower,
      ci_upper,
      OR_95CI,
      p_value,
      stable_estimate,
      significant,
      plot_status,
      stability_flag
    )
  
  write.csv(
    full_table,
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_full_table.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  significant_stable_table <- full_table %>%
    filter(
      significant == TRUE,
      stable_estimate == TRUE
    )
  
  write.csv(
    significant_stable_table,
    file.path(plot_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_significant_stable_table.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  plot_df <- df %>%
    filter(
      significant == TRUE,
      stable_estimate == TRUE
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      colour_group = ifelse(taxon %in% names(colour_palette), taxon, "Other"),
      p_label = paste0("p = ", signif(p_value, 2)),
      taxon = reorder(taxon, odds_ratio)
    )
  
  if(nrow(plot_df) == 0){
    
    empty_plot <- ggplot() +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = 1,
        y = 1,
        label = "No significant stable BMI-adjusted associations",
        size = 5
      ) +
      labs(
        title = plot_title,
        x = NULL,
        y = NULL
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank()
      )
    
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_forest_plot.png")),
      plot = empty_plot,
      width = 8,
      height = 5,
      dpi = 300
    )
    
    return(empty_plot)
  }
  
  x_min <- min(plot_df$ci_lower, na.rm = TRUE) / 1.5
  x_max <- max(plot_df$ci_upper, na.rm = TRUE) * 2
  
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = odds_ratio,
      y = taxon,
      colour = colour_group
    )
  ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 1,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_errorbarh(
      aes(
        xmin = ci_lower,
        xmax = ci_upper
      ),
      height = 0.2,
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 3.2) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        x = ci_upper,
        label = p_label
      ),
      hjust = -0.15,
      size = 3.5,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    scale_x_log10(
      limits = c(x_min, x_max)
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = colour_palette, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = "Odds ratio (95% confidence interval)",
      y = "Taxon"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0(file_stub, "_forest_plot.png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 8.5,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(p)
}

make_table_and_plot(
  data = bmi_results,
  domain_name = "Fungal",
  outcome_name = "outcome",
  file_stub = "fungi_TERM_vs_sPTB_BMI_adjusted",
  plot_title = "BMI-adjusted fungal associations with spontaneous preterm birth",
  colour_palette = fungal_colours
)

make_table_and_plot(
  data = bmi_results,
  domain_name = "Fungal",
  outcome_name = "sPTB34",
  file_stub = "fungi_sPTB34_BMI_adjusted",
  plot_title = "BMI-adjusted fungal associations with birth before 34 weeks",
  colour_palette = fungal_colours
)

make_table_and_plot(
  data = bmi_results,
  domain_name = "Viral",
  outcome_name = "outcome",
  file_stub = "viruses_TERM_vs_sPTB_BMI_adjusted",
  plot_title = "BMI-adjusted viral associations with spontaneous preterm birth",
  colour_palette = viral_colours
)

make_table_and_plot(
  data = bmi_results,
  domain_name = "Viral",
  outcome_name = "sPTB34",
  file_stub = "viruses_sPTB34_BMI_adjusted",
  plot_title = "BMI-adjusted viral associations with birth before 34 weeks",
  colour_palette = viral_colours
)

write.csv(
  bmi_results,
  file.path(plot_dir, "all_BMI_adjusted_results_with_stability_classification.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
